text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whoaaaa~!? Ahhh... A live birthday 
greeting voice... My ears are melting...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I wonder if they liked our present 
too?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
H-H-H-Yes! Of course I enjoyed it to the 
fullest!! Both of your gifts will become 
family heirlooms~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The milk pudding Dants-san gave you is all 
the rage among the girls right now! Plus, 
that wrapping means it's definitely a rare 
find!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And I got a keychain from Believe-san! 
It's a carving of the crest of the academy 
where us Umamusume gather! Those delicate 
curves... such incredible skill...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing, Digital-chan! Yeah, I really 
paid attention to the details~!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The curve on the school crest... That took 
quite some time. You have a sharp eye, 
Digital-san.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? What?! N-No, no, no, no! Of 
course I should savor a gift I went 
through the trouble of getting~!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Especially... someone of my kind tends to 
pick up on habits and little quirks, you 
see...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, no. Sticking to my guns was definitely 
the right call! âThank you, 
Digital-chanâª

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hwah!? Hyueh!? I-I-I'm so utterly honored 
and humbled, eek!?
